selection_reason: Official NLSC boundary; bounded 69.5 km2 township; full CMR footprint overlap for the exact October 16 pre-event and October 28 post-event track 061/frame 076 descending HH/HV scenes; real pixel QA completed for both scenes.
candidate_comparison: Mailiao and Yuanchang were evaluated with official boundaries and CMR footprints, but their pixel-level coverage was not downloaded or measured. Taixi was selected for one bounded flagship analysis, not claimed to be a confirmed damage hotspot or globally optimal pixel-coverage candidate.
independent_impact_context: MOA reports Yunlin County agricultural losses, not Taixi township or field losses.
